newsitem.title: INDIA: India's IFCI plans $150 mln GDR - paper.
newsitem.headline: India's IFCI plans $150 mln GDR - paper.

text.p: Industrial Finance Corporation of India Ltd (IFCI) has drawn up plans for a $150-million issue of global depositary receipts (GDRs), the Financial Express said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said details on the pricing and the launch of the issue would be decided at a meeting of IFCI's board on June 26.
The company's annual results for 1996/97 (April-March) are also scheduled to be considered on that day.
Financial Express said IFCI was consulting investment banks on the proposed GDR issue, and had shortlised a few likely to be asked to manage the issue.
